posts.topic_title: Q: About HOE's in combination with solar heating

posts.post_subject: Q: About HOE's in combination with solar heating
posts.content_md:
While I haven't done it, I'm sure it's been attempted. Seems to me that a fresnel lens would be more efficient if you merely want to focus the light down to a smaller area.

What's your ultimate goal in "optimizing" your solar heating system?

posts.topic_title: Q: About HOE's in combination with solar heating
posts.author: Leif
posts.post_subject: Q: About HOE's in combination with solar heating
posts.content_md:
Of course my prime goal is to optimize my solarheating, perhaps with some "virtual and parabolic mirrors (HOE's)"?

But also try to reflect more daylight into the house, by using "holographic windows". The daylight has to be reflected towards the whitepainted ceiling and contribute to the indoor lighting. (I guess the use of photopolymers might be useful).

During the summer with a high sun height, I would also like to see the windows act like mirrors. 8)
